about_the_game:
Get a first look at Core Descent, a puzzle-platformer focused on exploration, collectible hunting, and gradually deepening puzzle challenges. This demo lets you explore a portion of the game’s world, try out core mechanics, and experience a preview of what’s to come.

Key Features:

  • Challenging Puzzles: Test your problem-solving skills with a variety of puzzles that grow more complex as you progress.

  • Engaging Platforming: Traverse diverse environments, mastering jumps and maneuvers to overcome obstacles and reach new areas.

  • Rewarding Collectibles: Discover and collect gems and orbs scattered throughout the world. Some are hidden in plain sight, while others require skill and exploration to uncover.

  • Deep Exploration: Every zone is layered with secrets waiting to be found. From off-the-path puzzles to hidden challenges and optional upgrades, your curiosity is always rewarded—what starts as a simple detour might lead to something much bigger.

Immerse yourself in Core Descent and build your puzzle-platforming skills as you descend toward the heart of the planet.

Please note:
This demo represents an early slice of the game and does not reflect the final quality, scope, or feature set of the full release. Visuals, sound, level design, and gameplay systems are subject to change.
